messages.content: Independently review whether a verification-passing source change actually satisfies the stated objective, every constraint, and every structured test vector. A vector id in a title or comment is not coverage. For each vector, locate assertions that exercise its when operation and prove all then and forbidden clauses. Reject globally if any vector is incomplete. Judge only supplied evidence. Return contracted JSON.

Some vectors lack clear control assertions to validate their behavior in the modified source.","vectorVerdicts":[{"accepted":false,"id":"omitted-root-traversal","missing":["Explicit assertion checking for both operations succeeding in the 'then' clause","Observations confirming only public/match.txt is observable","Forbidden checks against private/secret.txt and improper refusal due to root traversal base." ]},{"accepted":false,"id":"dot-root-traversal","missing":["Assertions that affirm dot normalizes to the empty relative root","Assertions confirming only admitted descendants are returned","Forbidden items concerning private filenames and bytes." ]},{"accepted":false,"id":"directory-and-file-admission","missing":["Assert that the directory admission correctly exposes both public descendants","Confirming that direct read remains confined by the same admission predicate","Assertions against sibling or ancestor becoming readable through exact-file admission." ]},{"accepted":false,"id":"explicit-private-base-refusal","missing":["Assertions ensuring structured JSON refusal is returned correctly","Assert that the refusal only identifies the base being outside the declared readable scope","Assertions against protected filenames and improper walking of private before refusal." ]},{"accepted":false,"id":"unrestricted-compatibility","missing":["Assertions confirming that unrestricted behavior is preserved in the context of readablePaths being omitted or empty","Assertions against accidental deny-all behavior when readablePaths are empty." ]}]}
